title: Geometric invariance predicts sensor blind spots: a pre-registered comparison of 23 methods on simulated NV-diamond thermometry
description: Pre-registered experiment comparing 23 geometric methods and 7 scalar baselines across five decoherence axes in simulated NV-diamond intracellular thermometry. Contains analysis code, pre-registration (frozen under commit SHA 8401d54), deviation log, and raw results (150,000 method evaluations, 100 seeds, bootstrap CIs). The central finding is that translation-invariant methods are structurally blind to device calibration variation, the dominant noise source in multi-sensor deployments.
notes: Pre-registration frozen under commit SHA 8401d54. All results are fully deterministic and reproducible from the frozen commit and seed pool (seeds 1000-1099).
